Test Case Title: Add to cart via direct product URL (no prior homepage visit) [BUG]
Preconditions: Browser context fresh (no cookies), never visited homepage
Test Steps:
1. Navigate directly to /prod.html?idp_=1
2. Click "Add to cart" button
3. Confirm "Product added" dialog
4. Navigate to /cart.html
5. Verify product in cart table
Expected Result: Product should appear in cart (1 row), Total = 360 USD. Root cause: Cookie 'user' only set by index.html, not prod.html → empty cookie → /viewcart returns shared bucket of 589+ items from other users
Actual Result: Currently: Cart shows 589 items (other users' data) or empty, BUG rò rỉ giỏ hàng
Notes: DEF-SYS-001: Guest cart identity not established outside homepage. Security/data leak issue. test.fail() – assert /viewcart payload returns 1 item

Test Case Title: Place Order modal button interaction during success popup (modal stacking bug)
Test Steps:
1. Add product ($360)
2. Open Place Order modal
3. Fill all fields with valid data
4. Click Purchase
5. Success popup appears (SweetAlert)
6. While success popup visible, try to interact with Place Order modal behind it (click Purchase button, modal fields)
Test Data: Product: Samsung Galaxy S6, Valid card: 4111111111111111, Valid month/year: 06/2027
Expected Result: Modal buttons/fields should be DISABLED or hidden while success popup is visible. Modal should not be interactive (no clicking Purchase again, no editing fields). Success popup should be only interactive element.
Actual Result: Currently: Place Order modal button is still visible, enabled, and clickable behind success popup (modal stacking issue)
Notes: DEF-005: Modal stacking issue. Success popup should disable underlying modal. Bug: button remains interactive during success confirmation, can cause duplicate orders if user clicks again.
